title: Quieter Vespers
description: A resource pack that lowers the volume of the screams made by Vespers from Alex's Caves.
body:
Tired of loud, obnoxious oversized bats screaming in your ear every time you DARE step foot into a Forlorn Hollows? Me too, very.

This resource pack lowers the volume of the Vesper's screaming, that way you won't need to lower your volume and be left unaware of other possible threats.

This needs [Alex's Caves](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves) to work.

Made with love and HATE.

_Mostly hate._

![We hate Vespers.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2321cb5eca289136308b48315b8a15cb04c08f91.png)
